decision.reason: [ev-3faa5287ea4e] says the ConsulCatalog `namespace` option is removed and would prevent Traefik from starting, and shows it set by YAML/TOML file or `--consulCatalog.namespace`. The proposal's cli-flag leaf is right, but it covers the file case with an undecidable leaf whose reason (environment-visibility-gap) isn't allowed, and undecidable is forbidden for config visibility. A correct file predicate needs the place the static config file is read from (CONFIG SOURCES or the ConfigMap data key, e.g. traefik.yml/toml). Neither the evidence nor the section context gives it, and a CLI-only condition would miss file-configured environments.
